purpose: Register unresolved brochure facts so source assimilation and release work can proceed without inventing values or repeatedly reopening low-priority gaps.

items.subject: YouClip count
items.unresolved_reason: Brochure page 8 describes five standard attachment points plus two optional points, while the page-22 grade matrix shows 4/5/5/5. The exact scope of the prose and matrix count is not reconciled.
items.next_action: Retain the source conflict; verify whether the prose count includes a different accessory/configuration scope before creating a normalized count.

items.subject: Front 12 V socket location and count
items.unresolved_reason: The page-22 matrix supports the luggage-compartment socket for some grades, but the current dictionary attribute does not represent the front socket or exact socket distribution.
items.next_action: Add a separate attribute only after a bounded data-model review; do not map the whole row to boot_12v_socket.

items.subject: USB-C port front/rear distribution
items.unresolved_reason: The matrix distinguishes two front ports and two rear ports for some grades; existing count/rear-presence attributes do not encode the full front/rear distribution.
items.next_action: Preserve the source wording and resolve a typed representation for port location and count before adding more observations.

items.subject: Media Display / Media Nav Live composite and screen size
items.unresolved_reason: The page-22 composite descriptions combine system identity, 10.1-inch screen, smartphone replication, speakers, services and update duration. Later source observations use a 10-inch label; these meanings must not be collapsed.
items.next_action: Split only facts with an exact active attribute contract and preserve the 10.1-inch versus 10-inch source distinction.

items.subject: Body-colour grade applicability
items.unresolved_reason: The six page-14 colour names and finish/two-tone markers are recorded as model-level catalogue items, but the brochure does not provide an exact grade/configuration compatibility matrix.
items.next_action: Use a dated source with explicit grade-level colour applicability; do not create configuration mappings from the model-level palette.

items.subject: Accessory product capacities and dimensions
items.unresolved_reason: The brochure states a 310-litre Aero Cargo Box, 60 kg roof-rack load and 1.90 x 1.30 m Sleep Pack surface. The current commercial-item model does not provide a semantically suitable accessory measurement contract.
items.next_action: Keep these facts in the source report until accessory product attributes have an approved model.

items.subject: Hybrid-G 150 4x4 cargo measurement context
items.unresolved_reason: The page-20 technical table and the same brochure's equipment matrix disagree about the tyre-repair-kit state for Hybrid-G 150 4x4; cargo values depend on repair-kit/spare-wheel context.
items.next_action: Retain the four source values as deferred; resolve the same-document equipment qualifier before importing cargo contexts.

items.subject: Page-23 interior dimensions and seat geometry
items.unresolved_reason: The page shows interior measurements 1443/1432 mm and seatback angle 14 degrees; these are not exterior dimensions and no exact active attribute contract/applicability is established.
items.next_action: Do not map these values to exterior width/height or other unrelated attributes; revisit only with a dedicated interior-geometry schema.

items.subject: 2025 brochure equipment-package identity and components
items.unresolved_reason: The page-22 EASY, PARKING, WINTER and WINTER PLUS markers are composite package references; current 2026 commercial package identities and components do not prove the exact 2025 package state.
items.next_action: Keep the 2025 package markers separate until dated package identity and component applicability are explicitly reconciled.

handling_rules: This ledger is not master data.
Never use 'Do sprawdzenia' as a technical or commercial value.
Do not infer values, applicability, or availability.
Keep evidence from the 2025-12-10 brochure separate from later 2026 price-list evidence.
Populate source_pages only when verified from the exact source.
Resolved items remain in resolved_items for audit history; they are not open gaps.
A model-level colour palette item does not establish grade/configuration availability.
